requirement: Design parent is the accepted I1 governance closure
Design changes no Rust Cargo deploy config workflow or remote state
Target host identity and SSH host-key fingerprint are exact
Ubuntu systemd architecture CPU memory and disk floors are explicit
P1 owns DB15 and never mutates DB0
P1 namespace service identity config root state root and binary are distinct
Existing P0 runtime and WS services remain unchanged
Redis remains loopback-only protected AOF-enabled port 6379 with 16 databases
DB15 must be empty and all P1 paths absent before first provisioning
Source implementation precedes every remote action
Read-only immutable preflight precedes provisioning
Provisioning cannot reload enable or start a service
Network-isolated bootstrap precedes ordinary service start
Synthetic acceptance precedes read-only FINAM-bar acceptance
Every operational phase has a single-use signed bounded manifest
Phase escalation and unattended activation are forbidden
Readiness is PaperReady and LiveReady is forbidden
Synthetic session is bounded to 30 minutes
Read-only FINAM-bars session is bounded to 180 minutes
Service is stopped and disabled after each session
DB15 and durable state are retained unchanged for review
Clean SIGTERM is evidenced
Pre-effect SIGKILL restart is evidenced
Stale PEL reclaim is evidenced
Exact duplicate is idempotent
Conflicting duplicate fails closed
Uncertain paper-provider outcome recovers without repeat effect
FINAM phase uses market-data-only read-only credentials
Supervisor has no FINAM dependency and no order HTTP or command consumer
Installed files systemd security and activation state are retained
DB15 inventory groups lifecycle streams and PEL are retained
DB0 has no P1 namespace before and after every phase
Durable hashes telemetry runtime state and lifecycle projections are retained
Logs and process network evidence are redacted and secret-scanned
Any identity scope namespace readiness or lifecycle mismatch stops the phase
Installation Redis FINAM dispatch runtime-live and real orders remain unauthorized by design
